conflicts.title: KO vibration unit definition unresolved - engineering validation required
conflicts.detail: KO3201_VIB is MM/S in PI Tag; weekly DE radial vibration is micron. No conversion, joining, or micron threshold applied to hourly data.
conflicts.source: Production Data - RCA2 KO-3201.xlsx / PI Tag vs Equipment Performance / Condition History

conflicts.title: KO oil-pressure evidence contradicts across sources
conflicts.detail: RCA2 slide 6 reports normal 1.8 barg. Weekly failure row reports 1.078 barg. Retain both; validate instrument and sampling context.
conflicts.source: RCA2 slide 6 / Equipment Performance KO Condition History

conflicts.title: KO vibration thresholds have different contexts
conflicts.detail: RCA2 slide 7 describes historical 60 micron alert; slides 5–6 and Equipment Info specify 45 micron. Prototype uses 45 micron only on weekly displacement, as unapproved demo configuration.

conflicts.title: HE discharge pressure is not tube-side differential pressure
conflicts.detail: HE3301_DISP remains generic discharge pressure (BARG). Fouling uses weekly Tube-side dP (bar).
conflicts.source: Production Data - RCA4 HE-3301.xlsx / PI Tag

conflicts.title: HE 13 OFF samples versus 12 hours elapsed downtime
conflicts.detail: Hourly OFF rows span 21-May 09:00 through 21:00 inclusive (13 samples). RCA reports 09:00–21:00 = 12 elapsed hours. Do not equate samples with duration.

conflicts.title: Weekly records cannot be rate-normalized from supplied hourly flow
conflicts.detail: Weekly timestamps are date-only and extend outside the hourly month. No synchronized feed rate, pressure pair, or validated correction model exists; normalized values must remain unavailable.

conflicts.title: KO weekly contamination precedes RCA narrative window
conflicts.detail: Weekly water first exceeds 500 ppm on 11-Feb; RCA describes approximately two weeks pre-trip. Historical temporal precision differs; no guaranteed warning claim.

conflicts.title: Equipment nameplate template fields require validation
conflicts.detail: HE Equipment Info includes bearing/seal design-life text and generic monitoring method. Do not use these template fields as verified exchanger design.
